name: What are common signs that my electric water heater needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my electric water heater needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your electric water heater needs repair include a lack of hot water, inconsistent water temperature, strange noises like popping or rumbling coming from the tank, visible leaks around the unit, or a sudden increase in your energy bills. Discolored or foul-smelling hot water can also indicate a problem. Before contacting us, you can check if the circuit breaker for the water heater has tripped, as this is a common, easy-to-resolve issue. However, persistent problems usually require professional diagnosis.
